name: Frankie's Feline Fund
neighborhoods: Manhattan (Upper East Side / Upper West Side); foster-based, no shelter building
region_note: SENIOR & SPECIAL-NEEDS CATS - rescue, adoption and owner surrender (Manhattan)
notes: All-volunteer 501(c)(3) rescuing abandoned elderly and special-needs cats. Adoption ($75 fee) and a senior-to-senior foster programme. Accepts owner surrenders of senior cats to keep them out of the shelter system. A different organization from Frankie's Friends, which helps pay vet bills. Intake: Email frankiesfelinefund@gmail.com or call 917-514-0228
